description: File takes from takes_list to a planned post (its id), a topic (its id, or a name: a topic with that name is made when there is none), B-roll or unfiled. The phone moves them on its next sync. Nothing is deleted, and undo puts each take back where it was.

id.description: The post's id for post, the topic's id for topic

kind.description: post: a planned post (id); topic: a topic (id, or name to find or make one); broll: B-roll; unfiled: not filed

name.description: topic only, in place of id: the topic with this name, made when there is none

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: take_file
title: File takes
